title: Replace Non-Coprime Numbers in Array
goal: Repeatedly merge adjacent non-coprime values into their least common multiple.
strategy: A stack stores a settled prefix. Each incoming value may merge with the top; the new LCM can expose another non-coprime neighbor, so keep merging backward until the boundary is coprime.
